note: HELD: not to be rented until the owner says so in their own words in the laptop thread (rentals need them). 26 Nov 2026, the owner: "If their research can benefit us we should attempt to implement it" (ISTA DASLab's GSQ-RCO quants). RCO (arXiv 2605.00649, no code published) picks a type per tensor so a file lands on an exact size with the least drift. This run tries our own version on Bill (Flash-Next REAP60, 308 of 512 experts), whose stock IQ2_XXS failed the gate: pod/tensor_err measures every tensor's error at every stock type from the cut's own Q8_0 and its imatrix (processor only, sampled rows), then pod/rco_pick.py picks types under an exact byte budget. RC2_A is the size of stock IQ2_XXS (abs error; the rel variant was dropped 26 Nov to fit the money left, as it lost in the dry run), RC2_S is the size of MX2_S (the hand recipe that passed on 24 Nov). IQ2_XXS and MX2_S are made again so KLD compares like with like on the same reference run. Stock llama.cpp types only: the files load on stock llama.cpp and Lamplight. Nothing is uploaded (cut.publish false). Nothing is healed or trained. One RTX PRO 6000. Estimate 2.7-3.3 h at the forge table price $2.69/h, about $7-9 (24 Nov's five-file run cost $7.14; this makes four files and adds the error measure, 15-40 min); caps 3.5 h / $9.50, inside the $9.65 left of the owner's $14 go after the 26 Nov try that stopped on a missing keep list (the live price is checked before renting).
